tile_layout: row-major padded 32x32 BF16 tiles, 2048 bytes per tile

add.supports: equal-shaped tensors, or same-shaped lhs/output plus a rank-1 trailing-dimension rhs broadcast

mul.supports: equal-shaped tensors with identical tile grids

mul_scalar.supports: same input/output shape and tile grid

relu.supports: same input/output shape and tile grid

matmul.supports: rank-2 BF16 matrices with 32x32 padded tiles; transpose views of constant weights are materialized

conv2d.supports: rank-4 NCHW BF16 convolution packed into shared 32x32 GEMM blocks

max_pool2d.supports: rank-4 NCHW BF16 max pooling, unit dilation, no ceil mode

flatten.supports: rank-4 NCHW to rank-2 flatten from dimension 1
